title: Opinion: Opinion | Trump's Midterm Rout Eases India's Worries. But It Doesn't End Them
summary_full: The midterm outcome offers immediate psychological relief for India. But it may not change much when it comes to thorny issues such as tariffs or regulatory frameworks. There, Trump still holds the gavel.
